The Block names the investor as 'Asylum'; matched to Asylum Ventures via the firm's own companies page listing The Clearing Company.

Stages (pre-seed/seed) and $1-2M checks appear in search summaries and a fetch summary only, not as quotable text; not recorded. asylum.vc shows no application route.
